executive_summary.problem_statement: Currently, the product only supports single-city trip bookings (origin-destination or single-city stay). Users are unable to plan and book complex journeys involving multiple cities or legs within a single transaction, leading to fragmented booking experiences and potential loss of business for multi-destination travelers.
executive_summary.objective: Enable users to plan and book complex journeys involving multiple cities or legs (flights, hotels, and other services) in a single trip and single transaction flow, reusing existing trip and booking infrastructure where possible.
goals: Support multi-city trip creation with multiple legs (cities/stays) in one transaction
Persist and use multi-city itinerary in trip–booking linkage (today cities from CreateTripRequest are not persisted in createTripDraft)
Complete multi-city flight booking flow (hold, order/da, order/pg) — MultiCityFlightMount currently has hold/order endpoints commented out
Support multi-city hotel search and booking tied to trip legs
Unify trip-finding logic so hotel bookings can be matched to trip legs (findTripForHotel currently returns null)
non_goals: Changing the file_bb746bb82b1b repo (file upload/scanner service — not travel)
Rebuilding flight/hotel provider APIs; use existing DomesticFlight/PersonalDomesticFlight multiCity endpoints
Supporting multi-city for Bus/Train/Visa in initial scope unless already present in codebase

user_personas.responsibilities: Creates trips, adds flight/hotel requests, submits for approval
user_personas.key_need: Create one trip with multiple cities/legs and add all flights and stays to that trip without creating separate trips per leg

user_personas.responsibilities: Creates trips on behalf of employees/guests, holds and confirms bookings
user_personas.key_need: Search and book multi-city flights and multi-city stays in one flow and attach all to a single trip
See one coherent multi-city itinerary and approve the full journey

functional_requirements.title: Multi-City Trip Creation and Persistence
functional_requirements.description: Trip draft creation must persist the cities/itinerary from the request so that subsequent booking and trip-finding logic can use it.
business_rules: CreateTripRequest already defines List<City> cities (models/jsons/CreateTrip/CreateTripRequest.java). createTripDraft in BookingQueries must map request.getCities() into Trips (e.g. citiesMap attrs and/or TripItinerary list) so that findTripFor* and UI can rely on it.

Trip type is already set as MULTI in createTripDraft (attrs type = MULTI); ensure itinerary structure matches TripItinerary (city, startTime, endTime, travel) and TripCitiesConfig (models/jsons/Trip/TripCitiesConfig.java).
system_behavior: On createTripDraft: persist cities from CreateTripRequest into Trips.cities (List<TripItinerary>) or attrs citiesMap (TripCitiesConfig) as done in Trips.addCity() in models/sql/Trips.java.
TravelDesk CreateTripController (travel/Trips/TravelDesk/CreateTripController.java) does not accept cities; extend to accept optional cities/itinerary for multi-city trips.
validations: Reuse existing tripFixedDuration and start/end date validation in BookingQueries.createTripDraft; ensure multi-city date ranges fall within trip startDate/endDate.
Validate city IDs against Cities/CityQueries where applicable.

functional_requirements.title: Multi-City Flight Booking Flow
functional_requirements.description: Enable hold and order (DA/PG) for multi-city flight searches so that a multi-leg flight can be booked in one transaction.
business_rules: Flight multi-city search already exists: travel/Flight/MultiCity/InitSearchController.java, MultiCitySearchRequest (models/travel/MultiCitySearchRequest.java), FlightProvider.multiCitySearch, DomesticFlight.multiCitySearch (apis/meta/flight/DomesticFlight.java). MultiCityFlightMount (travel/Flight/MultiCity/MultiCityFlightMount.java) currently has hold, order/da, order/pg, and flightChoices commented out.
Reuse patterns from one-way and round-trip: travel/Flight/HoldFlightController, CreateDaOrderController, CreatePgOrderController, and travel/Flight/Round/* equivalents.
system_behavior: Implement or wire MultiCity hold and order controllers (e.g. MultiCity/HoldFlightController, CreateDaOrderController, CreatePgOrderController) that accept MultiCitySearchRequest/MultiCityReviewRequest and call FlightProvider.multiCityReview, then existing order/DA/PG flows where provider supports it.
Cache and session handling should follow ApiCache.QUERIES.save/forImplant pattern used in InitSearchController and one-way flow.
validations: Reuse origin/destination/date validation from InitSearchController (MultiCity) and ensure sector sequence matches trip itinerary when tripId is present.

Reuse findTripForFlight-style logic for multi-city: match trip by iterating trip.getCities() (TripItinerary) for each sector origin/destination/date (see BookingQueries.findTripForFlight and findTripForRoundFlight).

functional_requirements.title: Trip–Booking Linkage for Hotels (Multi-Leg)
functional_requirements.description: Hotel bookings must be linkable to a specific leg/city of a trip. Today findTripForHotel returns null; tripId is passed manually in HoldHotelController.
business_rules: StaySearch and StayRequest (models/travel/StaySearch.java, StayRequest.java) are single-city (city, checkIn, checkOut). For multi-city trips, hotel search can remain per-city but must be associable with a trip and optionally a leg (city) of that trip.

HoldHotelController (travel/Hotel/HoldHotelController.java) already accepts tripId and validates trip when tripRequiredForImplant; extend to optionally validate that the stay city/dates align with a leg of the trip.
system_behavior: Implement findTripForHotel in BookingQueries (models/queries/BookingQueries.java): given employee and StayRequest (city, checkIn, checkOut), find a trip whose itinerary (getCities() or citiesMap) includes that city and date range.
When tripId is provided, optionally auto-fill or validate that the stay matches one of the trip's cities/legs.
validations: Reuse existing hotel validations (session, hotelId, roomId, travellers). If tripId present and findTripForHotel is implemented, validate stay city/dates overlap with trip leg.

functional_requirements.title: Single-Transaction and UX Consistency
functional_requirements.description: User can add multiple legs (flights and stays) to one trip and submit for approval as one journey.
business_rules: Trip remains the single unit for approval and reporting (existing status flow: DRAFT → PENDING → APPROVED/DECLINED; BookingStatus.TRIPAPPROVAL etc. in utils/data/enums/BookingStatus.java).

Existing plugins (tripRestrict, tripFixedDuration, tripRequiredForImplant, tripDraftEmail, etc.) in utils/data/jsons/Plugins.java and CompanyPlugins.java apply to multi-city trips without change unless specified.
system_behavior: Trip details and booking lists already key by trip_id (e.g. travel/Trips/TripDetailsController.java). Ensure multi-city itinerary is returned in trip details (cities(), getCities(), citiesMap).
Reports that aggregate by trip (e.g. reports/Impl/Travel/Common/TripsReport.java) should continue to treat one trip as one unit; multi-leg data available via existing Trips.cities / TripItinerary.
validations: Policy and budget checks remain per-trip; no new validation rule required for multi-city beyond date range and city consistency.

performance: Multi-city flight search already uses async CompletableFuture in InitSearchController; hold/order flows should avoid blocking on multiple provider calls where possible.
security: Reuse ImplantAccessMiddleware and EmployeeAccessMiddleWare; no new auth model. Trip–employee association and tripId validation already enforced in CreateTripDraftController, HoldHotelController, and flight flows.
scalability: No new storage model; use existing fintrip_ooo_trips table and attrs/cities. Cache keys for multi-city search already use diceId (ObjectId) in ApiCache.
observability: Use existing Logger and error handling (e.g. RoutingError, ResponseHelper.handleError) in new controllers.

proposed_technical_design.architecture_approach: Keep existing trip and booking models; add persistence of cities in createTripDraft, implement findTripForHotel, and enable multi-city flight hold/order by implementing the MultiCityFlightMount handlers reusing one-way/round patterns.

files_to_create.purpose: Hold multi-city flight after review; mirror Round/HoldFlightController using MultiCityReviewRequest
Create DA order for multi-city; mirror Round CreateDaOrderController
Create PG order for multi-city; mirror Round CreatePgOrderController

files_to_modify.changes: In createTripDraft: map request.getCities() to Trips (citiesMap and/or TripItinerary list). Implement findTripForHotel(Employee, StayRequest): find trip where getCities() or citiesMap contains a leg with matching city and overlapping checkIn/checkOut.
Wire hold, order/da, order/pg (and flightChoices if needed); add handlers for HoldFlightController, CreateDaOrderController, CreatePgOrderController.
Optionally accept cities/itinerary in request body and persist via Trips.addCity() or attrs citiesMap for multi-city travel-desk-created trips.

proposed_technical_design.data_flow: 1) Employee/TravelDesk creates trip with cities → createTripDraft persists cities to Trips. 2) Multi-city flight: init → polling → review → hold → order/da or order/pg; tripId attached. 3) Hotel: search per city; hold with tripId; findTripForHotel can validate stay against trip leg. 4) Trip details and approvals unchanged; all bookings linked to same trip_id.

user_stories: As an employee, I want to create one trip with multiple cities and dates so that I can add all my flights and hotels to a single trip.
As an employee, I want to add a multi-city flight (e.g. A→B→C) to my trip in one booking so that I don't have to create separate trips per leg.
As an employee, I want to add hotels in different cities to the same trip so that my whole journey is under one approval.
As travel desk, I want to search and book multi-city flights and attach them to a trip so that the traveler gets one itinerary.
As an approver, I want to see one trip with multiple legs and approve or decline the entire journey.

failure_scenarios.scenario: Multi-city flight provider returns partial or failed results
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Reuse existing status (ONGOING/COMPLETED/FAILED) and error handling in InitSearchController and ApiCache; surface message to client; allow retry.

failure_scenarios.scenario: User adds hotel in a city not in trip itinerary
failure_scenarios.mitigation: When findTripForHotel is implemented, optionally warn or reject if city/dates do not match any trip leg.

failure_scenarios.scenario: Trip dates fixed (tripFixedDuration) but user adds leg outside range
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Reuse tripFixedDuration and date checks in createTripDraft; ensure sector/stay dates within trip startDate–endDate where plugin enabled.

backward_compatibility: Existing one-way and round-trip flows remain unchanged. Trips without cities (existing drafts) continue to work; cities() returns empty or from existing attrs. New multi-city hold/order live under /flight/multiCity/*. Frontend can continue to use /flight/init and /flight/round for single-origin-destination; multi-city is additive.
